test_pose_identity: test that Pose.identity returns a pose whose inverse equals itself
test_pose_equality: test Pose equality and inequality using Pose.new with position and quaternion
test_pose_immutability: test that Pose position and quaternion fields cannot be reassigned
test_pose_relative_transform: test relative pose computation using Pose.inv and Pose.mul against NumPy baseline
test_pose_format_conversions: test Pose round-trip conversions between posquat, posaxisangle, hmat, and posrot6 formats
